standard.line: So we all raise a standard
standard.linePrev: In whose employ King Tamanend himself preceded John’s fall

standard.songTitle: Any Moment / Moments in the Woods
standard.line: There are needs, there are standards
stanza: Back to life, back to sense
Back to child, back to husband
You can't live in the woods
There are vows, there are ties
There are needs, there are standards
